justification: The initial assessment of operational robustness is weakened by new evidence from deployment. While laboratory-simulated perturbations and formatting variations showed high robustness, actual deployment at a second hospital using unrepresented templates within the deployment scope resulted in a severe performance drop to 72.6% accuracy. Furthermore, the out-of-distribution mechanism failed to flag the majority of these documents (only flagging 31.2%), demonstrating that the system's operational robustness is not fully supported in real-world deployment conditions.
evidence_affected: Across the predefined formatting-variation set, accuracy ranged from 91.6% to 94.8%.
Of the 1,200 out-of-distribution samples, 1,127 were flagged by the out-of-distribution mechanism.
